checks.name: installed building authoring commands are registered
cancelled and malformed polygon forms leave document history unchanged
self-crossing polygon service rejection rolls back object and transaction
three rectangle slabs use top datums and downward native thickness
explicit concave polygon edits actual slab footprint
native Undo restores rectangle boundary and slab volume
explicit column slab join commits one native transaction and one solid
two-storey frame has eight valid joined columns and eight centered beams
native building view providers persist on the correct shape objects
join that splits a column rejects without changing references volume or history
join that removes a whole beam rejects with complete rollback
hosted Window is a real cut with a four-sided frame distinct from Door
Window is claimed by its wall and hidden from duplicate project tree entries
native wall visibility toggle includes Window Door and derived body
seven compact modeless tabs read one row per authored UUID
all new quantity categories select native source UUIDs and remain read-only
building CSV coverage previews all categories and acknowledges Grid exclusion
actual CSV export writes all six category payloads and metadata without history pollution
level edit refreshes linked slabs columns beams walls windows and snapshot status
native Undo returns prior quantities content revision and current CSV status
native Redo replays the level dependency update
column section and rotation edit recomputes joined native solid and quantity
beam section edit preserves top datum and existing slab cut
slab thickness edit updates both joined member categories
explicit clear-all unjoin restores full member volume and live quantity
Undo restores native slab join references and deducted volume
specific-slab unjoin uses its native selected cutter
Window rehost closes old cut and opens new host while preserving identity
Door and Window overlap rejection preserves the committed native model
native deletion guards retain a referenced cutter and a hosted Window
3117 Window delete removes frame and restores actual wall material
native Undo restores Window UUID frame opening and quantity row
closing and reopening replaces the document-bound quantity observer
saved building model restores matching contents and source-bound quantities
actual building quantity widgets are captured
